title: Power Rankings: San Antonio Spurs up to No. 1
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 10
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Something that has to worry the rest of the league on top of the Spurs' well-chronicled new identity offensively and D that can still get into you (ask Kobe): How well will they be flowin' after the magical Rodeo Road Trip?

rankings.summaryHtml: How did the Heat become the first team in history to go 10-0 on the road over the course of a month? Stifling D and a resurgent D-Wade were the two keys next to LeBron's ridiculous December: 25.2 ppg, 7.9 rpg, 6.8 apg.
